oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1791234567 created • P1 • Silverpine (Dedicated EU pool) — paging #eng-oncall #incidents
Mira: Acked. Oncall runbook linked: https://redwood.run/playbooks/dedicated-outage
Leo: I'm in. Seeing spike in 503s from eu-west-2 pool starting 08:14 UTC. Autoscaler is flapping.
Samir: Samir (ops) here — can you confirm affected customers list?
Lia: CS confirms Silverpine degraded for API generation calls; embeddings and async batch unaffected. Silverpine CSM: Dan Miller.
Leo: stack traces show Triton workers OOM-ing on quantized-ggml v2. Rolling up nodes to trigger fallback routing.
Mira: Status page draft below — please review before I publish.
StatuspageBot: DRAFT:
- Summary: Partial outage affecting Dedicated EU GPU pool causing 5xx responses for some enterprise customers (affects inference/generation endpoints).
- Status: Investigating
- Impact: A subset of enterprise dedicated customers may see 5xx or increased latency when calling hosted endpoints in eu-west-2. Not affecting embeddings or private clusters.
- Mitigation: Traffic is being shifted to compatible fallback variants in us-east-1 with best-effort routing; expect increased latency ~200-600ms.
- ETA: 90 minutes for capacity stabilization and rollback to normal routing.
Samir: Looks good, minor wording tweak: change 'Not affecting embeddings' -> 'Embeddings largely unaffected; small percentage may see retries.'
Mira: Updated and publishing now.
StatuspageBot: Published status update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791234567
Lia: CS copy for Silverpine (tailored):
---
Hi Dan,
We’re investigating a partial outage impacting the EU dedicated inference pool. You may experience intermittent 5xx errors or slower responses for generation calls. Our engineers have shifted traffic to a fallback in the US and are stabilizing capacity. Recommended short-term workaround: set client timeout to 30s and enable client-side retries with exponential backoff (2 retries).
Expected full recovery: ~90 minutes. We'll update you every 30 minutes and immediately if anything changes.
Apologies for the disruption — Lia, CSM
---
CS_Manager: I'll send that now and loop in Priya if no response within 10 minutes.
Leo: Mitigation steps executed:
1) drained problematic worker nodes
2) triggered fallback routing: api-routing set to prefer us-east-1 for silverpine-service (command below)
```
redwood route update --service silverpine-service --prefer-region us-east-1 --max-latency-ms 1200
```
3) applied temporary autoscaler cap to prevent thrash
Mira: Ops note for oncall handoff at 09:30 UTC: if error rate < 2% and latency stable, de-escalate to P2 and update status.
Samir: Posting internal comms template for SRE->Sales ops & Legal
INTERNAL TEMPLATE:
Subject: P1 — Silverpine (Dedicated EU) — current status
Body: Short summary, impacted customers list, mitigation actions, ETA, action items for sales/support (who to call), escalation contacts.
Contact routing for Silverpine (for paging):
- Primary: Dan Miller (CS) — dan@silverpine.com — +1-415-555-0123
- Secondary: Priya Singh (Infra Lead) — priya@silverpine.com — +44-7700-900123
- Account Exec: Marco Ruiz — marco@redwood.ai
Lia: Confirmed we have both DMs and phone numbers. I'll update the customer routing sheet and notify sales ops.
Leo: Metrics trending: 503 rate down from 8% -> 3% in last 8 minutes after draining; CPU on fallback nodes at 72%.
Mira: Good. I'm taking ownership of the customer-facing updates. Leo — keep working mitigation, Samir — prepare postmortem draft skeleton.
Samir: On it. I'll start a doc and add timelines.
CS_Manager: Silverpine replied: 'Thanks — appreciate the quick update. Please keep us posted.'
Mira: Noted. Next status update at 08:50 UTC (30m cadence). If anyone needs to add to the customer message, drop it here.
Leo: FYI, we may need to disable quantized-ggml v2 kernel for eu pool—planning a config flip if error persists.
StatuspageBot: Next scheduled update will be at 08:50 UTC. tag: #status-updates
oncall-bot: Incident assigned to Mira (incident commander) and Leo (lead engineer).
